settings.title: Prices and payment
settings.text: All prices are in Danish kroner and include 25% VAT. We accept MobilePay, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay [and Klarna]. Your card is charged when [the order ships].

settings.title: Delivery
settings.text: We deliver in Denmark only. Delivery is free to a parcel shop, a locker or your door, normally within 1 to 2 working days. Orders placed before [cut-off time] on weekdays ship the same day.

settings.title: Your right to cancel (fortrydelsesret)
settings.text:
You can cancel your purchase within 14 days of receiving the goods, without giving a reason. Tell us by email or use the form below or our returns page.

Return the goods within 14 days of telling us. Returns are free with our label. We refund the full amount, including original delivery, within 14 days of receiving your cancellation. We may wait until we have the goods back.

You may handle the goods as you would in a shop. If they lose value because they were used more than that, we may deduct the difference. [Gift cards and personalised items: confirm exceptions.]
